findings.title: ProcessGroup accepts a non-positive pid, retargeting the signal to pid 1 or to Tamoz's own process group
findings.recommendation: Add a positive-Integer pid guard to both class methods in process_group.rb raising the existing ConfigurationError, matching the validate_*! idiom at cancellation_token.rb:41-43. Do not add a class or file.

findings.title: Token-driven cancellation is not durably recorded as cancelled; it degrades to the "failed" fallback
findings.recommendation: Map a cancelled run to a stable "cancelled" reason in WorkerRuntime#terminal_reason instead of the "failed" fallback at worker.rb:1182, reusing the RunResult(status: :cancelled) value that already exists at executor.rb:547-550. No new machinery.

findings.title: An omitted pool cancellation token is silently replaced by a fresh, never-cancellable token
findings.recommendation: Make the intent explicit or raise ConfigurationError in cancellation_for when neither an override nor a default token is present, mirroring the validation already in Pool::Base#initialize.

findings.title: ProcessGroup addresses a group id by number with no proof it still owns that group (pid-reuse window)
findings.recommendation: State the unreaped-still-owned precondition in the primitive's existing documentation comment rather than adding a kill(0, pgid) identity re-check; both call sites already hold the ownership fact. Close on the 'cannot happen by construction' rule if the coordinator agrees.

findings.title: A second SIGINT during shutdown is a no-op and each signal delivery spawns an unbounded thread
findings.recommendation: None required. The documented promise (trap.rb:5-10) is that no stop request is lost and no handler deadlocks; both hold. A force-quit escalation is an owner contract decision, not an audit fix.

blind_spots: No durable run was executed, so F02-OBS-01's stored terminal reason is inferred from worker.rb:1180-1183 and not observed.
No signal storm was driven; the thread-per-signal amplification in F02-COR-01 is a shape, not a measured rate.
Pid reuse (F02-REL-01) was not reproduced; the kernel allocator race was out of budget, so the finding rests on source arithmetic plus the absence of an identity re-check.
The comms gateway trap site (cli_comms_commands.rb:130-163) was read but no gateway was run; its shutdown completeness belongs to row F12.
tamoz-stream and tamoz-agent-session cancellation wiring was traced at construction only (situation_request.rb:490, session.rb:396); behavior under cancellation belongs to F06/F22.
There is no unit test for ProcessGroup anywhere in test/; the primitive is only exercised indirectly through MCP and check-runner suites.
